## Copyright & licensing checklist

> We can only accept resources that are legal to share. Please confirm:

- [ ] This resource is **legally free to distribute** (official free copy,
      open license / Creative Commons, public domain, or the author has made it
      freely available).
- [ ] It is **not** a pirated copy of a paid book and does **not** link to a
      shadow-library / piracy site.
- [ ] I've added it as a **link to the official source** where possible (rather
      than uploading a file).
- [ ] I'm adding **one resource** in this pull request.
- [ ] I've read the [Contributing Guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to
      the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
